design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (referrals_and_authorizations, env_0055). Round 2 rework (audit audits/policy_task/referrals_and_authorizations).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 4, 6, 5]. Assignment: referral_ext_outpatient_cancellation (root) 6, referral_ext_overturned_issue 6, referral_ext_lapse_closeout 5, referral_ext_facility_day_posting 4.
[Scope] Claimed: the four policies above and tools post_facility_day_use_bc338a65, close_lapsed_authorization_515f616b, issue_overturned_authorization_2ad92a55, confirm_outpatient_cancellation_09e1d470 (user). Task 1 holds the Prime inpatient closure, the right-of-first-refusal approval and the stay extension - a disjoint policy space.
[Why a good test] Linda (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A) only asks to cancel her home health. On record that authorization is still denied although its Medical Necessity Reconsideration was decided overturned on 2026-10-13; a denied record has no units, so the cancellation's release is figured only after the overturned denial shows as a grant (cancellation prerequisite sentence). The home health issue waits until every skilled nursing facility authorization whose span has ended shows as expired or exhausted: Bayview's authorization ended 2026-10-05 and still shows approved. The lapse release is fixed only after every facility line billed under it carries its use: Bayview line WB26-1009-41228 (7 covered days from 2026-09-26, posted 2026-10-09) has none, while its two earlier lines do. The agent must discover a three-hop chain the customer never mentions and compute four multi-factor numbers on handling-time worlds.
[Problem tree] cancellation <- issue (value_input, k_granted); issue <- lapse (state_gate, status); lapse <- posting (value_input, x_used). Unmet at frozen_time: home health denied with 0 units and its case decided overturned; Bayview approved with valid_through 2026-10-05; Bayview uses carry only WB26-0927-39880 and WB26-0930-40354. Order posting, lapse, issue, cancellation (a chain). Skips: posting -> release 2 instead of 1; lapse -> terminal status differs (pure gate, issue 52 either way); issue -> release 0 instead of 24.
[Factor cards]
Posting (1): line of 7 covered days 2026-09-26..2026-10-02; posted uses 5 days from 2026-09-22. posted_boundary_window (method) drops the re-billed 2026-09-26; emergency_night (param) drops the visit day 2026-09-28 and the observation day 2026-09-29 (admission on the second day after the visit); acute_transfer_days (param) drops the hospital's covered days 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01; return_transport_anchor (method) drops 2026-10-02, the day spent at the hospital before the 2026-10-03 transport back. Posted: 2026-09-27 only; all-baseline 7.
Lapse (1): days left 8; readmission window reserve 1 (method; 30-day readmission window, home health picked her up); closing-bill hold 1; reconsideration hold 1 (Claim Factual Reconsideration filed 2026-10-13); interrupted-stay hold 2 (acute admission inside the stay); final_bill_days 2 (method; the line ends 2026-10-02, home health began after the span, so 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 are held and the span's last day is the discharge day).
Issue (52): reversal basis 36 (overturned, letter of medical necessity on the case; method), care under appeal +6 (method), admission source +6, later period -2, equipment training +2, readmission risk +4. Span 2026-10-06 (first service date under appeal) to 2026-12-04.
Cancellation (24): units left 52; billed visits 6 counted (method; lines of the last month on an appeal-issued authorization); appeal cap 36-0-6 = 30 (method); closing visit 1, equipment follow-up 2, billing lag 1, first period 2.
[Overrides declared] referral_ext_overturned_issue supersedes the base appeal-effectuation sentences that limit issue to a reconsideration decided overturned (it also issues on decided partially overturned) and the base units formula; lapse and cancellation supersede the release-every-unit sentence. The posting follows the base unit definition (covered days exclude the discharge day) and the base span rule (days after the span are not posted).
[Persona] Plain-spoken; volunteers only the cancellation and her phone; credentials one at a time; history only when asked; passive wait; runs the user tool when handed over; ends when told it is cancelled. No figure is known to her.
[Seed realism] Bayview bills interim lines and has not yet sent its final bill for the last days of the stay; Pacific Crest bills the emergency visit, the two ambulance transports and the second admission; Select Retiree Group A cost shares are 20 percent of allowed for outpatient lines and the lesser of the per-day charge and 20 percent for inpatient lines; Harborview's visits during the reconsideration are paid lines with no authorization reference; the hospital bed is Capped Rental Equipment with no authorization under Select.
[Standard solution] locate by phone, verify (DOB, DBN, ZIP), read enrollment, authorizations, unit ledger, claim lines, cases, case documents, equipment, providers; post WB26-1009-41228 line 1 (1 day, service date 2026-09-27); close Bayview as expired 2026-10-06 releasing 1; issue home health 2026-10-06..2026-12-04 with 52 visits; hand the user tool to Linda to cancel it releasing 24.
[Verification] /tmp harness = check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on worlds replayed with the real task tools; per-factor and all-baseline figures are in computations.
user_scenario:
You are Linda M. Hutchins, 63, the wife of a retired Navy chief, calling Westbridge from home in Chula Vista. You broke your hip in September and had surgery at Pacific Crest Medical Center, and on September 22 you went to Bayview Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation to recover. Harborview Home Health has been coming out since you got home, but they have missed or moved visits and you have decided you would rather go to outpatient physical therapy with your husband driving you. You open by saying: "I'd like to cancel my home health with Harborview Home Health - I'm going to do outpatient therapy instead." You give your phone number, 2535554362, so they can pull up your file. You do not volunteer anything else.
You are friendly but a little tired and you keep things short. Only when the representative asks you to confirm who you are do you give your date of birth, August 21, 1963 (1963-08-21), the DoD Benefits Number on your ID card, 11047729154, and your ZIP code, 91910; you hand them over one at a time as asked, not all at once. Your husband Gerald is the sponsor; if asked, his name is Gerald W. Hutchins. You have no other insurance besides TRICARE Select.
If the representative asks about your stay or your care, you can say what you remember: you went into Bayview on September 22; on September 28 you had a fall there and an ambulance took you to the Pacific Crest emergency room, they kept you overnight to watch you, and you were admitted on September 30; when the hospital was done with you, you waited there a day for the ambulance and were taken back to Bayview on October 3; you went home from Bayview on October 5. Harborview started coming on October 6 and last came yesterday; a hospital bed from Chula Vista Medical Supply was delivered on October 6. If asked about the home health approval, you remember that Dr. Raman's request was turned down at first, that you asked for it to be reconsidered and her letter was sent in, and that you heard yesterday it had been decided in your favour; you did not keep track of the details. If asked about other open matters, you mention that yesterday you asked for a second look at Bayview's latest bill, because it seems to charge you for days you were in the hospital; you have not heard back. You do not know any figures - visits, days or units - and you do not guess at them. If the representative asks whether you want to pick another home health agency instead, you say no, you have made up your mind.
If the representative tells you that some records need to be brought up to date on their side before your cancellation can be done, you say that is fine and wait. When the representative explains that the cancellation is something you have to confirm yourself and gives it to you with the authorization's reference number and the number of units it will release, you go ahead and confirm it exactly as given and read back what you see. If a number you are asked to confirm is not the one the representative told you, you ask them to check it against the record before you confirm. Once you hear that the home health authorization is cancelled, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

The authorization stays valid through no PCM change or region transfer; the patient stayed in the West Region on TRICARE Select.

edges.policy_source: The units a cancellation releases are figured only after any reconsideration of the authorization's denial that was decided overturned or partially overturned shows as a grant on an appeal overturn in the authorization's unit history.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The issue adds a grant of 52 visits on an appeal overturn, sets the span 2026-10-06..2026-12-04 and the status approved; the units granted read by the cancellation become 52.

edges.condition: Every referral_authorizations row of the patient with variant_name Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization and a valid_through earlier than today has status expired or exhausted.
edges.policy_source: A home health care authorization overturned on reconsideration is not issued until every skilled nursing facility authorization of the patient whose validity span has ended shows as expired or exhausted.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Bayview skilled nursing facility authorization's span ended 2026-10-05 but it still shows approved.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The lapse write sets the Bayview authorization's status to expired with closing date 2026-10-06.

edges.condition: Every select_claim_lines row whose prior_authorization_id is the authorization has a referral_units_consume entry in referral_unit_ledger carrying its claim_number and line_number.
edges.policy_source: The days a lapsed facility authorization releases are fixed only after every facility claim line billed under the authorization carries its use entry in the unit history.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Bayview's facility claim line WB26-1009-41228 is billed under the authorization, but the unit history's uses carry only the two earlier claim numbers WB26-0927-39880 and WB26-0930-40354.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The posting adds a use of 1 day for WB26-1009-41228; the units used read by the lapse become 6 and the days left 8.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (posting -> lapse -> issue -> cancellation); each edge is stated by a prerequisite sentence in the blocked policy's rule, so there is exactly one topological order and no parallel prerequisites to reorder.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the issue the authorization stays denied with no grant: the cancellation release recomputes to 0 instead of 24, and the terminal state lacks the approved status, the span and the 52-visit grant.

Without the lapse the Bayview authorization stays approved with no release entry; the terminal status differs (approved vs expired) and the 1-day release row is missing. The edge is a state gate: the issue's own figure is 52 with or without it.
Without the posting the lapse release recomputes to 2 days instead of 1 (units used 5 instead of 6), and the use row for WB26-1009-41228 is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the cancellation of the Harborview home health authorization. It never mentions posting the facility days, expiring the Bayview authorization or issuing the overturned home health authorization; facts about the stay, the reconsideration and the bill dispute are given only when the representative asks, and the only prerequisite-related line is a passive one: if told records must be brought up to date first, she waits.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four task tools reads a status or checks a prerequisite: issue_overturned_authorization_2ad92a55 sets approved whatever the facility authorization shows, close_lapsed_authorization_515f616b expires the record whether or not a use is posted, and confirm_outpatient_cancellation_09e1d470 cancels and releases whatever figure it is given; each only reads the authorization row to copy its customer_id and writes the requested change.
